September 12, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-12-1971-54685

Mahmud Ali, vice-president of PDP, also an envoy of Pakistan government, comes back from Europe and US trip. He says that European radios, televisions and newspapers are reporting that East Pakistan is facing an ‘accident’. Pakistan’s military junta doesn’t care about the fair election results. Because the result is not pro-West Pakistani. European intellectuals advise to talk to the winning leaders and deal a negotiation for peace.
